evals.prompt: 根据这两份客户 docx 输出适合产品经理看的需求文档和商业模式解释，需要业务流程图、身份升级、奖励结算、报价工期。
evals.expected_output: A concise PM requirements document with industry terms, business model, identity rules, reward formulas, ASCII flows, open questions, and phased quote/timeline.

evals.prompt: 这个需求文档太长了，整理得比原文还长没意义，帮我压缩成 PM 好阅读的版本。
evals.expected_output: A shorter rewritten document that keeps only core business logic, required formulas, flows, open questions, and quote assumptions.

evals.prompt: 把客户发来的商业奖励方案整理成开发可确认的需求说明，重点写清每个奖励算法和结算周期。
evals.expected_output: A requirements brief that emphasizes reward algorithms, formulas, settlement timing, user identity relationships, and unresolved rule conflicts.
